definitions.explanation: The source or beginning of something; where something came from.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{由来|ゆらい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To research the origin of this word.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{由来|ゆらい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That festival has an ancient history.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{由来|ゆらい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the origin of the name.

notes:
{由来|ゆらい} refers to the origin, history, or story behind something — how a name, custom, place, or thing came to be.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {由来|ゆらい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to derive from, to originate from
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{由来|ゆらい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to originate in/from ~
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{由来|ゆらい}: the origin of a name
- ⟦{地名|ちめい}→地名：04059_chimei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{由来|ゆらい}: the origin of a place name
- {由来|ゆらい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have an origin/history

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {由来|ゆらい}: origin, derivation (how something came to be)
- ⟦{起源|きげん}→起源：17394_kigen⟧: origin (more scientific/formal, e.g., origin of life)
- ⟦{語源|ごげん}→語源：14215_gogen⟧: etymology (specifically word origins)
- ⟦{来歴|らいれき}→来歴：15072_raireki⟧: history, career (of a person or thing)

USAGE:
Can also function as an adverb meaning "originally" or "by nature": {由来|ゆらい}⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{島国|しまぐに}→島国：12339_shimaguni⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧ (Japan is by nature an island nation). This usage is literary.
